notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0.1.0.1
notes.content:
EDIT: This patch had previously caused an issue with firing the gun, the problem has now been resolved. I hope it didn't affect anybody too badly! 

Just a small patch for today! More to come tomorrow :) thanks to everyone who's left feedback so far!


[list]
[*]Tutorial equipment is now placed closer inside the bounds, making it all easier to reach for players with smaller play areas.
[*]A confirmation noise players with every tutorial objective completed.
[*]Paintballs now come out of the holders at an increased rate and the capacity has been upped to 50 paintballs per holder.
[*]Paintballs from the holder are now smaller and the collision bounds inside the hopper have been modified slightly.
[*]Collision bounds on the weapons locker have been fixed.
[*][spoiler]A special case has been added in during the Paintbot introduction stage if a player uses up all their ammo.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Shooting the paintbot in the chest during the paintbot introduction stage will now destroy it bit by bit.[/spoiler]
[/list]
